chunks: If God brings you back to a group of them, and they seek your permission to go out, then say: 'You will never go out with me again, nor will you fight with me against the enemy. Indeed, you preferred to stay behind on the first occasion, so stay behind with those who stay behind.'
ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet deny the Hypocrites permission to go to battle again?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the event of the Prophet's departure for Tabuk, where the hypocrites' repeated excuses revealed a deep-seated spiritual lethargy. The command 'accompany the laggers' (al-khālifīn) signifies that their voluntary withdrawal from jihad placed them in the company of those who remained behind, marking a permanent shift in their spiritual status. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the consistency between inner belief and outward action, particularly in the context of communal struggle.
